view.definition:
SELECT g.id,
    g.user_id,
    g.agency_id,
    p.full_name AS name,
    g.availability,
    g.avatar_url
   FROM guards g
     LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = g.user_id;

policies.qual: (is_platform_admin() OR (owner_user_id = auth.uid()) OR has_agency_access(id, false) OR (status = 'approved'::agency_status))

helper_functions.name: has_agency_access
helper_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_agency_access(p_agency_id uuid, p_admin_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.agencies a
    left join public.agency_members am
      on am.agency_id = a.id
     and am.user_id = auth.uid()
     and am.is_active
    join public.profiles p on p.id = auth.uid()
    where a.id = p_agency_id
      and p.account_status = 'approved'
      and (
        a.owner_user_id = auth.uid()
        or (
          am.user_id is not null
          and (not p_admin_only or am.role = 'agency_admin')
        )
      )
  );
$function$

helper_functions.name: is_platform_admin
helper_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid()
      and p.role = 'platform_admin'
      and p.account_status = 'approved'
  );
$function$
